items.title: Declare the machine that signs this repository’s record
items.detail: Every sealed entry here carries assertedBy: agent/kopman-build-ci, and no directory fragment in the estate declares that id. The signature currently cites an identity that formally does not exist.

items.title: Publish a directory/1 fragment for this repository
items.detail: This repository seals a record and publishes no directory fragment, so nothing it asserts can be resolved by a reader and its emitter cannot be declared anywhere.

items.title: Move the GitHub default branch off an agent’s scratch branch
items.detail: The GitHub default branch is claude/repo-update-EeLrY. Work pushed to main here deploys nothing and is read by nobody, and the failure is silent because the push succeeds. Only the repository owner can change this.
